title: 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross Blends Capability, Utility and Style for the Just Right SUV

body_markdown:
- Corolla Cross Hybrid Model Available in SE and XSE Grades and with an EPA-Estimated 42 MPG Combined Rating
- Corolla Cross Hybrid Features Standard Electronic On-Demand AWD (e-AWD) and 196 Total System Horsepower
- Corolla Cross Gas Model Available in L, LE, and XLE Grades with Available Front Wheel Drive (FWD) or Dynamic Torque Control AWD and 169 Horsepower
- User Friendly Driver’s Cockpit Across All Grades and Available 10.5-Inch Toyota Audio Multimedia Touchscreen
- Assembled in the United States in Huntsville, Alabama
- Starting MSRP of $25,535 for the Corolla Cross L Gas Grade and $31,415 for the Hybrid SE Grade


**PLANO, Texas (** **Oct. 2, 2026)** –The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross blends practical utility, surprising capability, and a stylish design that hits a sweet spot for everyday living. Heading into its sixth year in the Toyota lineup, Corolla Cross gives customers a versatile compact SUV interior, with an elevated seating position and folding rear seats to maximize cargo space. Its choice of gas or hybrid powertrains, and available front- or all-wheel drive (FWD or AWD), make it ready for the daily commute and weekend adventures alike. Style is also in the mix, with unique looks for gas or Hybrid models, seven single- and four two-tone colors, and an interior with thoughtfully designed storage and user-friendly tech.


**What’s New**
For model year 2027, the Corolla Cross hybrid lineup simplifies from three to two grades, dropping the S grade and going to a choice of well-equipped SE or XSE grades. Across the rest of the lineup, the model’s features and specifications carryover from the prior model year.


The 2027 Corolla Cross models are expected to arrive at Toyota dealerships across the United States this fall. Gas models have a starting Manufacturers Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) of $25,535 (L FWD grade) and hybrid models have a starting MSRP of $31,415 (SE grade) excluding Dealer Processing and Handling fee,[click here](https://pressroom.toyota.com/toyota-full-line-pricing/) for the latest Toyota Pricing information.


**Designed to Make the Most of Everyday**
The Toyota Corolla Cross presents a refined yet capable SUV appearance, balancing clean lines with a confident stance. Built on the TNGA-C platform, its exterior design brings together the familiarity of the Corolla family with the elevated ride height and utility of an SUV.


The Corolla Cross offers distinct grille designs that help differentiate gas and Hybrid models, with a modern, color-matched grille for the Hybrid model and a wide, rugged look for the gas-powered models. Depending on grade and powertrain, available features such as LED lighting, available two-tone exterior paint, and different wheel treatments give Corolla Cross an approachable and modern look that makes it an attractive entry in Toyota’s SUV lineup.


Inside, the Corolla Cross emphasizes comfort, usability, and smart packaging. The cabin is designed to support daily commuting, weekend errands, and road-trip flexibility with a layout that prioritizes both driver confidence and passenger convenience. Interior features include:


- An intuitive cockpit design focused on ease of use with console, center, and door storage
- Folding 60/40 rear seating designed to support practicality and passenger comfort
- Flexible rear cargo space for groceries, gear, and travel needs
- Available technology like a 10.5-inch touchscreen, wireless Qi charging, and 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster


The cabin strikes a balance between simplicity, durability, and functionality for a modern appeal.


**Gas and Hybrid Powertrain Choices**
Toyota offers the Corolla Cross with two distinct powertrain paths, giving customers flexibility based on their driving preferences.


The gas-powered Corolla Cross is equipped with a responsive 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine designed to deliver balanced performance and everyday efficiency. It produces a punchy 169 horsepower and has a physical first gear for a straightforward, familiar driving experience with the confidence expected from a compact SUV.


The Corolla Cross’ AWD gas model has a manufacturer estimated 29/31/30 city/highway/combined MPG combined rating; FWD equipped gas models have a manufacturer estimated 30/32/31 city/highway/combined MPG combined rating.


For customers interested in added efficiency, the Corolla Cross Hybrid pairs Toyota’s hybrid technology with standard all-wheel-drive, delivering a well-rounded combination of fuel economy and confident traction. The Corolla Cross Hybrid has an impressive manufacturer estimated 46/39/42 city/highway/combined MPG rating on both Hybrid grades.


**Front-Wheel Drive and All-Wheel Drive Availability**
The Corolla Cross gas grades are available with FWD or AWD, providing an efficient and accessible configuration for many drivers. For those who choose a gas-powered AWD model, Toyota’s clever Dynamic Torque Control system directs up to 50% of power to the rear wheels when it’s needed – and disengages completely when it’s not. This feature helps Corolla Cross’ fuel economy.


For Corolla Cross Hybrid models, the e-AWD system has the capability to deliver added traction for slippery road conditions. It employs a high-output IPM (Interior Permanent Magnet) motor that drives the rear wheels and works seamlessly to preemptively distribute driving force to the rear wheels to help suppress front wheel slip during off-the-line starts. It also engages the rear motor in response to slippage at the front wheels and enhances cornering agility by helping to reduce understeer.


Towing capacity is 1,500 pounds on both front- or all-wheel drive models.


**Key Features Across the Lineup**
Great value is evident throughout the Corolla Cross lineup. From the entry-level gas L grade to the feature-packed Hybrid XSE grade, key standard features include:


**Gas Models**
**L Grade:**


- 2.0-L 4-cylinder DOHC 16-valve engine
- Rugged grille and bumper design
- Fabric-trimmed seats
- 8-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen
- 7-in. digital gauge cluster
- Wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™ compatibility
- SiriusXM® 3-month trial subscription
- Rear HVAC vents
- Toyota Safety Sense 3.0
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Two front USB-C charging outlets
- LED headlights and taillights
- 17-in. steel wheels with silver wheel covers


**LE Grade — Adds to or replaces L features with:**


- Qi wireless charging
- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
- 17-in. silver painted alloy wheels
- Roof rails
- Smart Key with Push Button Start
- Leather-trimmed steering wheel
- Auto climate control
- Four total USB-C charging ports
- Color-keyed heated power outside mirrors with turn signals


**XLE Grade — Adds to or replaces LE features with:**


- 18-in. machine-finished alloy wheels
- 10.5-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen
- SofTex®-trimmed seats
- 10-way power driver seat with lumbar
- Heated front seats
- LED DRLs and fog lights
- Rear Cross-Traffic Brake
- Front and Rear Parking Assist with Automatic Braking
- Dual-zone climate control
- Rear folding armrest with two cupholders
- HomeLink rearview mirror
- Leather shift knob
- Tonneau cover


**Hybrid Model** **s**
**SE Grade**


- 5th generation Toyota Hybrid Electric Vehicle System
- Standard Electronic On-Demand AWD
- Sporty, high-tech front grille and bumper design with smoked front Toyota emblem
- Color keyed rear spoiler and door handles
- 7-in. digital gauge cluster
- Fabric-trimmed seating
- 6-way manual adjustable driver’s seat; 4-way adjustable passenger seat
- 8-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen
- Two front USB-C charging outlets
- Rear HVAC Vents
- 17-in. machined finished alloy wheels
- Toyota Safety Sense 3.0
- Leather-trimmed steering wheel with sport paddle shifters
- Black roof rails
- Rear privacy glass
- Rear windshield wiper
- Gloss black heated power outside mirrors
- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert
- Single zone Automatic climate control with rear seat vents
- Qi-wireless charging
- Four total USB Type-C charging ports (two front, two rear)


**XSE Grade — Adds to or replaces SE features with:**


- Fifth-generation Toyota Hybrid Electric Vehicle system
- Standard Electronic On-Demand AWD
- Color-keyed rear spoiler and door handles
- Gloss black heated power outside mirrors
- 12.3-in. digital gauge cluster
- SofTex-trimmed mixed-media seating
- 10.5-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen
- Two front USB-C charging outlets
- Rear HVAC vents
- Toyota Safety Sense 3.0
- 18-in. black-finished alloy wheels
- Dual-zone automatic climate control and rear-seat vents
- Rear folding armrest with two cupholders
- Ambient lighting
- HomeLink rearview mirror
- Tonneau cover


**Colorful Palette**
The following exterior colors are available across the Corolla Cross lineup, depending on grade:


- Celestite
- Jet Black
- Wind Chill Pearl**
- Soul Red Crystal**
- Cavalry Blue
- Sonic Silver
- Cypress
- Wind Chill Pearl with Jet Black Roof**
- Cavalry Blue with Jet Black Roof**
- Soul Red Crystal with Jet Black Roof**
- Sonic Silver with Jet Black Roof**


**Premium paint, additional charge.


**Additional Packages**
Optional packages available for Corolla Cross include:


- **JBL Premium Audio** — available for XLE and XSE grades, includes:


- Nine speakers (includes subwoofer)
- Amplifier


- **Multimedia Upgrade** — available for LE and SE grades, includes:


- 10.5-in. Toyota Audio Multimedia touchscreen


- **Moonroof Package** — available for LE and SE grades, includes:


- Moonroof
- Tonneau cover


- **Convenience Package** — available for XLE and XSE grades, includes:


- Power rear liftgate
- Moonroof


- **Cold-Weather Package** — available for LE AWD and SE grades, includes:


- Heated steering wheel
- Heated front seats


**Driver Focused Tech and Multimedia**
The 2027 Toyota Corolla Cross has a standard 8-inch touchscreen featuring the Toyota Audio Multimedia audio system, developed by the Texas-based Toyota Connected North America team. The system has six-speakers, standard, and supports wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™. A JBL® premium audio system with 9-speakers (including subwoofer) and amplifier is optional on the XLE gas and Hybrid XSE grade.


The L, LE, and Hybrid SE grades have a combination meter with analog gauges and 7-inch color Multi-Information Display (MID) with fuel economy, Driver Assist, vehicle/trip information, and warning messages. The XLE and XSE Hybrid grades have a 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster.


All 2027 Corolla Cross grades include a 5-year Connected Services trial for Safety Connect*** and Service Connect***. The LE, SE, XLE, and XSE grades have a 5-year Connected Services trial for Remote Connect. All 2027 Corolla Cross grades include a 30 day/3 GB Wi-Fi Connect*** trial. Additional services, such as Drive Connect***, are available depending on grade. Visit[Toyota Connected Services](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/) to learn more.


Owners can also use the Toyota App, with an active Remote Connect subscription or trial to find their Toyota in a crowded parking lot, start the engine, or lock the doors remotely, visit the[Toyota App](https://www.toyota.com/connected-services/toyota-app/) page on the Toyota Connected Services website to learn more.


***4G network dependent, subscription required after trial.


**Safety & Convenience**
All 2027 Corolla Cross models come standard with Toyota Safety Sense 3.0, Toyota’s suite of active safety and convenience systems. This suite of features includes:


- Pre-Collision System with Pedestrian Detection
- Full-Speed Range Dynamic Radar Cruise Control
- Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist
- Lane Tracing Assist
- Road Sign Assist
- Automatic High Beams
- Proactive Driving Assist


Additional standard safety features include:


- Toyota Star Safety System
- Blind Spot Monitor with Rear Cross-Traffic Alert (LE, XLE, SE, XSE)
- Safe Exit Alert (LE, XLE, SE, XSE)


**Limited Warranty**
Toyota’s 36-month/36,000-mile basic new-vehicle warranty applies to all components other than normal wear and maintenance items. Additional 60-month warranties cover the powertrain for 60,000 miles and corrosion with no mileage limitation. The Electric Vehicle Driving Components, including the traction battery, are covered for 8 years or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. Toyota dealers have complete details on the limited warranty.


The Toyota Corolla Cross also comes with ToyotaCare, a plan covering normal factory-scheduled maintenance, for one year or 10,000 miles, whichever comes first, and three years of Roadside Assistance, regardless of mileage.
